WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current),
sk AS (SELECT store_key, store_id FROM dim_store),
win AS (SELECT 'TY' yr, DATE '2026-05-04' s, DATE '2026-10-04' e UNION ALL SELECT 'PY', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-09-28'),
s AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id)=1),
a AS (SELECT w.yr, c.region, sum(s.net_amount) sales_all, sum(CASE WHEN s.staff_purchase_flag THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN s.channel_code<>'ST' THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nonst
 FROM s JOIN sk USING (store_key) JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=sk.store_id JOIN win w ON s.sale_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE sk.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT w.yr, c.region, sum(f.refund_net) ret FROM fact_return_line f JOIN sk USING (store_key) JOIN cur c ON c.store_id=sk.store_id JOIN win w ON f.return_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE sk.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
p AS (SELECT w.yr, c.region, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d JOIN cur c USING (store_id) JOIN win w ON d.business_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE d.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT a.yr, a.region, a.sales_all, a.staff, a.nonst, r.ret, p.rpt_gross, p.rpt_ret, p.rpt_net FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING (yr, region) LEFT JOIN p USING (yr, region) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
win AS (SELECT 'TY' yr, DATE '2026-05-04' s, DATE '2026-10-04' e UNION ALL SELECT 'PY', DATE '2025-04-28', DATE '2025-09-28'),
s AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code = 'ST' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1),
amounts AS (
  SELECT w.yr, k.store_id, s.net_amount AS amt FROM s JOIN dim_store k USING (store_key) JOIN win w ON s.sale_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE k.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.yr, k.store_id, -f.refund_net FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store k USING (store_key) JOIN win w ON f.return_date BETWEEN w.s AND w.e WHERE k.store_id < 900),
by_store AS (SELECT c.region, c.store_id, a.yr, sum(a.amt) AS net FROM amounts a JOIN cur c USING (store_id) GROUP BY ALL),
agg AS (
  SELECT region,
    sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'TY' THEN net END) AS net_sales_ytd,
    sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'TY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN net END) AS lfl_ty,
    sum(CASE WHEN yr = 'PY' AND store_id NOT IN (119,125,129) THEN net END) AS lfl_py
  FROM by_store GROUP BY region)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY lfl_ty / lfl_py DESC) AS rank, region, round(net_sales_ytd, 2) AS net_sales_ytd, round((lfl_ty / lfl_py - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY 1
